title: Callbacks on Repaired Items — Calloway Limited Home Warranty
content:
When a repaired item recurs, the homeowner reports it as a callback on the original claim item of the Calloway Limited Home Warranty. A callback is accepted on the original claim only when it is reported within the program's callback days, in calendar days, after the repair was completed. Counting starts the day after the completion date and the last counted day is included.

An accepted callback is approved under the original coverage basis even when that coverage period has since ended, carries no deductible or fee, and is numbered in sequence: 1 for the first callback on the item, then 2 and up. A recurrence reported later is a new claim item, decided under the coverage periods of its defect category.

The completion date and the report date are taken from the records of the claim item, matched by its item number.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical, 30-day callback period)

| Repair completed | Recurrence reported | Calendar days after completion | Treatment |
|---|---|---|---|
| 10 June 2025 | 10 July 2025 | 30 | Accepted callback on the original claim item |
| 10 June 2025 | 11 July 2025 | 31 | New claim item, decided under its coverage period |

## What an accepted callback carries

| Feature | Accepted callback |
|---|---|
| Coverage basis | The original basis, even if that period has ended |
| Deductible | None |
| Fee | None |
| Numbering | Sequence 1 for the first callback, 2 and up after |
